    <p class="coh-paragraph">On 8 June 1958, Peter Davey and 11 other students at Gonville & Cauis college hoisted a derelict Austin 7 van onto the roof of the Cambridge University Senate House, in the most ingenious of student pranks. The then Dean of Gonville & Caius, the Rev.
